In user-acceptance testing, operators could enroll a new identity in under one minute and identify a flagged person from live footage in an average of 12 seconds. The results demonstrate that a modular, open-source, multi-model architecture can provide broad surveillance coverage, cloud-based auditability, and flexibility for adding new detection capabilities while maintaining practical real-time performance.

</details>


### [150] [From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08904)
*Alexander Hackett,Arnaud Denis-Remillard,Axel Cassou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉-语言动作模型（VLA）在动作后训练过程中，其视觉-语言模型（VLM）的空间理解能力（特别是深度感知）损失了多少。通过对比权重匹配的基座VLM/VLA对（Molmo2-ER和MolmoAct2-LIBERO），发现VLA在所有层的深度解码能力都更差（"地板"效应），且在最后几层出现额外崩溃（"悬崖"效应）。因果定位显示悬崖效应源于晚期层MLP干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解构建VLA模型时，动作后训练对VLM原有空间理解能力（尤其是深度感知这一空间几何理解的基础能力）造成多大程度的破坏，以及这种破坏的机制来源。

Method: 对权重匹配的开源基座VLM/VLA对（Molmo2-ER和MolmoAct2-LIBERO）的每个解码器层进行深度感知探测。通过因果消融实验（晚期层MLP写入消融、注意力消融、基座VLM中的相同干预）来定位退化来源，并进行模块级分解分析。

Result: （1）VLA在每一层的深度解码能力都更差，形成持续的"地板"差距；（2）退化不均匀：基座VLM在最终层深度解码能力提升，而VLA则崩溃，形成额外"悬崖"；因果定位显示悬崖由晚期层MLP干扰导致，消融晚期MLP写入可恢复大部分终端解码能力，而注意力消融和基座VLM中的相同干预无此效果。

Conclusion: 动作后训练以非均匀方式破坏VLM的空间理解能力，主要机制是晚期层MLP写入的深度可解码性崩塌。基座VLM主要在前层MLP累积写入中承载深度信息，而动作后训练破坏了晚期累积写入中的这一信息。

Abstract: How much of a vision-language model's (VLM) spatial understanding remains after the action post-training process of building a vision-language-action model (VLA)? We probe depth perception, a primitive of spatiogeometric understanding, from every decoder layer of a weight-matched open-source base VLM/VLA pair: Molmo2-ER and MolmoAct2-LIBERO. First, the VLA decodes depth worse at every layer, a persistent gap we call the floor. Second, the degradation is not uniform: while the base VLM's depth decodability improves through its final layers, the VLA's collapses, an additional late-layer drop we call the cliff. We causally localize the cliff to late-layer MLP interference: ablating the late-layer MLP writes recovers the majority of the terminal decodability cliff, while matched attention ablations and the same intervention in the weight-matched base VLM produce no comparable recovery. A module-level decomposition explains this dissociation: the base VLM carries depth most accessibly in accumulated MLP writes, whereas action post-training collapses depth decodability in the late accumulated writes.

</details>


### [151] [ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08907)
*Delin Mao,Chenghao Sun,Jingwei Song,Chishui Chen,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ToolVision提出了一种多阶段训练方法，通过多智能体搜索-委员会评分管线解决SFT阶段工具调用模式模仿问题，并通过工具使用收益对比来消解RL阶段工具使用的奖惩错配问题，无需额外人工标注即可自动构建训练信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的SFT-then-RL训练范式在视觉工具调用学习中存在两阶段监督错配：SFT阶段从强模型蒸馏的轨迹可能依赖学生模型无法复现的感知能力，导致学生只模仿工具调用形式而不理解其用途；RL阶段基于结果的奖励使工具执行失败成为负担从而抑制工具使用，而对所有正确工具轨迹的盲目奖励又会鼓励无效操作。

Method: SFT阶段：采用多智能体pipeline探索候选轨迹，由包含学生尺度模型的委员会对每步证据增益进行评分排序并剪枝，仅保留成功执行且最终答案正确的轨迹。RL阶段：先对比学习者有无工具时的表现差异，仅对工具有明确增益的问题给予成功工具使用的奖励。两个信号均从公开任务数据自动构建，无需人工标注工具使用或必要性。

Result: ToolVision-8B在全部7个主要基准上超过其基座模型，在全部3个高分辨率基准上超越Thyme-7B、CodeVision-8B和CodeDance-7B，并在V*和HRBench 8K上超过Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking。

Conclusion: 通过两阶段针对性的监督错配修正，ToolVision证明了在不依赖额外人工标注的条件下，能够有效增强多模态模型通过代码调用视觉工具进行图像推理的能力。

Abstract: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful. RL is expected to teach when to use tools, but outcome-only rewards make fallible tool execution a liability and suppress tool use, whereas a blanket bonus for every correct tool-using trajectory encourages valid but ineffective operations. To address these two misalignments, we introduce ToolVision. During SFT, a multi-agent pipeline explores candidate trajectories, and a committee including student-scale models scores stepwise evidence gain to rank and prune the search branches. Only successfully executed trajectories with correct final answers are retained for SFT. Before RL, ToolVision compares the learner's performance with and without tools, then rewards successful tool use only on questions where tools provide a clear benefit. Both signals are constructed automatically from public task data without additional human annotations of tool use or necessity. ToolVision-8B improves over its base on all seven main benchmarks, surpasses Thyme-7B, CodeVision-8B, and CodeDance-7B on all three high-resolution benchmarks, and outperforms Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking on V* and HRBench 8K. We will publicly release the datasets and source code.

</details>


### [152] [From Noise to Meaning: Meaningful Secret Sharing with Tamper Detection for Facial Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08924)
*Ajnas Muhammed,Iurii Medvedev,Nuno Gonçalves*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新方法，将人脸识别系统中视觉秘密共享产生的噪声状秘密份额嵌入到美观的封面图像中（利用自适应最低有效位隐写术），并结合数字水印和密码学哈希的双层认证机制来检测篡改，从而在保证隐私的同时消除份额的显著性并确保完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉秘密共享技术将人脸图像拆分为看似随机的秘密份额，但这些份额像噪声一样引人注目，容易被识别为加密内容而遭受定向收集和"先收割后解密"攻击；同时缺乏篡改检测能力，攻击者可修改份额威胁重构完整性。

Method: 提出一种综合框架：1）利用视觉秘密共享拆分人脸图像；2）采用自适应LSB隐写术将秘密份额嵌入具有感知透明性的封面图像；3）结合强数字水印与密码学哈希实现双层认证，保护份额完整性；4）通过多层机制抵御比特翻转、裁剪和替换攻击。

Result: 在多个公开人脸数据集上的大量实验表明，该技术在保持更好人脸识别准确率的同时，消除了秘密份额的显著性并保证了完整性，展现出对比特翻转、裁剪和替换攻击的高度韧性。

Conclusion: 该框架为面部数据保护设立了新标准，实现了隐私、安全和完整性的统一保障，使秘密共享既能隐蔽传输又具备抗篡改能力。

Abstract: Popularity of AI-based face recognition system directly demands protection of sensitive biometric data used for training. Visual secret sharing is an interesting idea, as it splits facial images into secret shares that look random and spread across many institutions. However, these shares look like noise and can easily spark suspicion and recognized as encrypted content. This makes them open to targeted collection and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Additionally, visual secret sharing does not detect tampering, allowing attackers to modify shares and threaten the integrity of reconstruction. In this paper, we introduce a new method that turns distracting noise-like secret shares into visually appealing cover images with additional cryptographic tamper detection. The proposed technique works with visual secret sharing and introduces cover images to embed the shares using adaptive least significant bit steganography. Here, cover images with perceptual transparency are used to store secret shares while guaranteeing complete privacy. A two layer authentication using strong digital watermarking and cryptographic hashing is used to protect the integrity of shares. The proposed technique shows high resilience in stopping bit-flipping, cropping, and substitution attacks. Extensive experiments on multiple public face datasets show that the technique shows better FR accuracy, while eliminating share conspicuousness and guaranteeing integrity. The proposed framework sets a new standard for protecting facial data in such a way that privacy, security, and integrity are protected.

</details>


### [153] [Zero-shot 2D Grounding with Novel Affordance Types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08929)
*Haomeng Zhang,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出零样本2D物体会话区（affordance）定位任务（NAT），引入NAT基准，并提出训练无关的AffordAnything方法和可训练的AffordAnything+变体，在AGD20K-NAT基准上比现有SOTA方法OOAL在IoU@0.4上提升了12.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D物体会话区定位研究仅关注训练中见过的会话语义类型，缺乏对模型泛化到新会话类型的探索，而这对于真实应用场景至关重要。

Method: 提出AffordAnything（训练无关方法），利用分割线索（object subpart与affordance区域之间的强相关性）来定位新会话类型；在此基础上提出AffordAnything+（可训练变体），学习如何组合这些分割线索以进一步提升性能。

Result: 在提出的AGD20K-NAT基准上，AffordAnything+比SOTA的OOAL方法在IoU@0.4指标上取得12.3%的绝对提升。

Conclusion: 利用分割线索可以有效解决零样本新会话类型的2D affordance定位任务，且可训练的线索组合方法能带来显著性能提升。

Abstract: 2D affordance grounding aims to locate the region of an object that a human can interact with. Existing research focuses on recognizing affordance types seen during training and does not study models' ability to generalize to novel affordances, which is crucial for real-world applications. We propose the task of zero-shot 2D grounding with novel affordance types (NAT) and introduce the NAT benchmarks. We then propose AffordAnything, a training-free method that leverages segmentation cues, motivated by the strong correlation between affordance regions and object subparts. To further improve performance, we develop AffordAnything+, a trainable variant that learns to combine these cues. On the proposed AGD20K-NAT benchmark, our best model AffordAnything+ achieves a substantial improvement of 12.3% (absolute) in IoU@0.4 over the SOTA affordance grounding method, OOAL.

</details>


### [154] [Can Webcam Gaze Constrain Mesa-Objectives in Driving Models? An Instrument Precision Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08947)
*Lennox Anderson,Ahmed Boutar,Jonah Mulcrone,Tal Erez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了自动驾驶危险检测系统中是否可以通过人类注视模式（WebGazer.js网页眼动追踪）来约束模型中间目标（mesa objective）的形成。基于137,663帧级注视样本和388个真实行车记录仪片段，跨两种校准协议、两种模型架构和五个随机种子进行实验，所有实验均未发现注视信息的统计学显著改进。几何分析表明根本原因在于WebGazer的测量误差（约130-257像素）超过了93%危险目标物体的尺寸（中位数36像素），在该仪器精度下无法实现目标级别的注视归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶中的危险检测系统可能发展出中间目标（mesa objective），即通过虚假相关性而非真正的危险识别来获得高训练性能。作者希望探索人类注视模式能否作为特权信息来约束这种中间目标的形成，从而提高系统对危险的真实理解能力。

Method: 使用WebGazer.js进行基于网页摄像头的眼动追踪，收集了137,663帧级注视样本并与388个真实行车记录仪片段的危险标注同步。实验设计包含两种校准协议（9点/45点击和11点/440点击）、两种模型架构（随机森林和因果Transformer）以及每个实验五个随机种子，并使用配对t检验进行统计分析。此外还进行了几何误差分析以探究注视信息无效的根本原因。

Result: 所有实验中，注视信息均未带来统计学显著改进（p值分别为0.919、0.578和0.667）。几何分析发现WebGazer报告的测量误差（约130-257像素）超过了93%检测到的危险目标物体尺寸（中位数36像素），意味着目标级别的注视归因在该仪器精度下物理上不可能实现。

Conclusion: 当前精度的网页眼动追踪技术无法有效约束自动驾驶危险检测系统中的中间目标形成，因为其空间误差过大，无法准确将注视点归因到具体危险目标。这强调了需要更高精度的眼动追踪硬件或替代性监督信号来解决mesa objective问题。

Abstract: Current hazard detection systems in autonomous driving may develop mesa objectives, learned internal goals that achieve high training performance through spurious correlations rather than genuine hazard recognition. We investigate whether human gaze patterns, captured via webcam-based eye tracking (WebGazer.js), can serve as privileged information to constrain mesa-objective formation. We collected 137,663 frame-level gaze samples synchronized with hazard annotations across 388 real dashcam clips, then test this hypothesis across two calibration protocols (9-point/45-click and 11-point/440-click), two model architectures (Random Forest and causal Transformer), and five random seeds per experiment with paired t-tests. No experiment yields a statistically significant improvement from gaze (p = 0.919, 0.578, and 0.667 respectively). A geometric analysis reveals the root cause: WebGazer's reported error (~130-257 px depending on configuration) exceeds 93% of detected hazard object sizes (median 36 px), rendering object-level gaze attribution physically impossible at this instrument precision.

</details>


### [155] [EndoMD-SLAM: Endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM under Optical Degradation with Memory and Static-Transient Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08949)
*Nuo Chen,Kangqi Ni,Lulin Liu,Joga Ivatury,Ying Ding,Farshid Alambeigi,Tianlong Chen,Zhiwen Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EndoMD-SLAM框架，专门应对临床内窥镜3D重建中因光学退化（如移动碎屑、冲洗）导致的追踪漂移和地图损坏问题。通过记忆驱动的门控机制和自监督静态-瞬态分解，系统能有效隔离视觉污染物，在严重退化下将绝对轨迹误差降低91%，渲染保真度提升9.9 dB PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯溅射SLAM系统依赖严格的多视角光度一致性，但在常规内窥镜手术中，移动碎屑和水冲洗等间歇性光学退化会严重违反此假设，导致系统将镜头附着伪影错误融合进持久3D几何，造成追踪漂移和不可逆的地图损坏，现有方法缺乏对此类退化场景的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出EndoMD-SLAM框架：(1) 追踪端采用记忆驱动门控机制，检测不可靠观测以暂停地图更新，并利用历史关键帧进行漂移感知重定位；(2) 建图端采用自监督静态-瞬态分解，将视觉污染物隔离到独立的瞬态场中，防止伪影与持久解剖地图结构纠缠；(3) 构建了基于结肠镜视频的退化聚焦基准数据集用于系统性评估。

Result: 在严重光学退化场景下，标准基线方法失效，而EndoMD-SLAM保持了几何完整性，绝对轨迹误差降低91%，渲染保真度（PSNR）提升9.9 dB。

Conclusion: EndoMD-SLAM通过专门的追踪与建图机制，有效解决了内窥镜场景中光学退化对SLAM系统稳定性的破坏，为临床内窥镜导航和文档记录提供了更可靠的密集3D重建方案。

Abstract: Dense 3D reconstruction is critical for clinical endoscopic navigation and documentation. While Gaussian Splatting SLAM systems show promise in this domain, they fundamentally rely on strict multi-view photometric consistency. In routine procedures, this assumption is severely violated by intermittent optical degradations like moving debris and water flushing. Standard systems erroneously fuse these cameraattached artifacts into the persistent 3D geometry, causing severe tracking drift and irreversible map corruption. To address this limitation, we propose EndoMD-SLAM, a framework designed to maintain stability under optical degradation through specialized tracking and mapping mechanisms. On the tracking side, a memory-driven gating mechanism detects unreliable observations to suspend map updates and utilizes historical keyframes for drift-aware relocalization. On the mapping side, a self-supervised static-transient decomposition isolates visual contaminants into a dedicated transient field. This explicit separation prevents artifacts from structurally entangling with the persistent anatomical map. We curate a degradationfocused benchmark from colonoscopy videos to systematically evaluate these failure modes. Extensive experiments show that while standard baselines fail under severe optical degradation, EndoMD-SLAM preserves geometric integrity, reducing absolute trajectory error by 91% and improving rendering fidelity by 9.9 dB PSNR.

</details>


### [156] [Topology-Aware Global-Local Mamba Networks for Palm Vein Biometrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08951)
*Zhengxi Wu,Felix Marattukalam,Waleed H. Abdulla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种拓扑感知的全局-局部骨干网络用于掌静脉识别，通过多尺度局部特征、基于Sobel边缘先验的结构引导方向流和四方向状态空间扫描全局通路，在六个拓扑感知块中集成，并采用分阶段门控融合。在HKPUNIR上取得99.13% top-1准确率和0.08% EER，仅7.2M参数；在VERA上取得92.42%准确率和0.61% EER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掌静脉识别属于细粒度生物识别任务，局部血管纹理和全局血管树布局都包含判别信息，但公开数据集有限，现有方法难以同时有效建模两种信息。

Method: 提出拓扑感知的全局-局部骨干网络，包含：(1)多尺度局部特征提取；(2)基于固定Sobel幅度边缘先验的结构引导方向流；(3)四方向状态空间扫描全局通路。这些组件集成在六个拓扑感知块中，并通过分阶段门控融合按局部、结构、全局顺序整合表示。

Result: 在HKPUNIR数据集上达到99.13% top-1准确率和0.08% EER（7.2M参数）；在VERA Palm Vein上达到92.42%准确率和0.61% EER。在两个数据集上均以最小参数量取得最低EER（对比ResNet50、Vim-S、ViT-S和GLVM），但GLVM在top-1准确率和FLOPs方面仍最优。

Conclusion: 所提方法在准确率和参数效率上具有竞争力，尤其EER指标表现优异，但GLVM在top-1准确率和计算效率上仍具优势，后续可在融合策略和全局建模效率上进一步优化。

Abstract: Palm-vein recognition is a fine-grained biometric task in which both local vascular texture and the global layout of the vessel tree carry discriminative information, while public datasets remain limited. We propose a topology-aware global-local backbone that combines multi-scale local features, a structureguided directional stream built on a fixed Sobel-magnitude edge prior, and a four-direction state-space scan global pathway within six Topology-Aware Blocks. A staged gated fusion integrates local, structural, and global representations in that order. On HKPUNIR, our method achieves 99.13% top-1 accuracy and 0.08% EER with 7.2 M parameters; on VERA Palm Vein, it achieves 92.42% accuracy and 0.61% EER. Across both datasets it attains the lowest EER among ResNet50, Vim-S, ViT-S, and GLVM at the smallest parameter count, while GLVM remains the strongest in top-1 accuracy and the cheapest in FLOPs. Code is available upon request.

</details>


### [157] [Damage Classification for 3D Point Cloud Data via 3D Data Analysis and Vision Foundation Model-based 2D Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08955)
*Evan Perez,Kalelo Dukuray,Erika Ardiles-Cruz,Jie Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文比较了两种三维点云细粒度损伤分类方法：基于3D点云分析的3PDA算法（结合TDA拓扑数据分析与异常检测）和基于2D投影分析的2PDA算法（利用视觉基础模型VFM）。3PDA精度更高但计算成本大、泛化性有限；2PDA精度略低但计算复杂度降低一个数量级，且适用于更广泛的物体类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维点云数据（PCD）的细粒度损伤分类面临高计算需求和标注数据稀缺的双重挑战，需要探索更高效的损伤评估方法。

Method: 1) 3PDA：使用PointNet对3D PCD进行分割，通过TDA提取紧凑的几何表示，再结合异常检测算法量化结构退化程度。2) 2PDA：将3D PCD投影为2D视图，利用大型视觉基础模型（VFM）进行细粒度损伤检测，显著降低计算成本。

Result: TDA能有效将VFM分割组件的几何结构压缩为判别性特征向量，异常检测模型可仅基于3D PCD可靠区分不同损伤程度的组件。2D VFM流程在细粒度损伤分类上表现强劲，3PDA精度更高但仅适用于窄范围的物体几何且计算成本高；2PDA精度略低但时间复杂度降低一个数量级，泛化范围更广。

Conclusion: 2D投影结合VFM的方法是传统3D架构的轻量级、资源高效替代方案，在计算效率与泛化能力上具有显著优势，尽管在精度上略有妥协。

Abstract: Fine-grained damage classification of 3D point cloud data (PCD) remains a persistent challenge, constrained by high computational demands and limited labeled data. This study examines two methods: 3D PCD-based damage assessment (3PDA) algorithm and 2D projection damage assessment (2PDA) In our 3PDA analysis algorithm, TDA is used to derive compact representations of 3D PCD segmented by pointNet, which are then integrated with anomaly detection algorithms to quantify structural degradation. We show that TDA effectively compresses geometric structure from VFM-segmented components into discriminative feature vectors and that anomaly detection models can reliably distinguish components with varying damage severity using only 3D PCD inputs. In the 2D projection analysis algorithm, we leverage large VFMs for granular damage detection by projecting 3D PCD into 2D views. These projections allow VFM based models to achieve competitive classification performance while requiring only a fraction of the computational cost associated with full 3D data processing. Our results demonstrate that 2D VFM pipelines in 2PDA can perform strongly on fine-grained damage classification tasks, highlighting their viability as lightweight, resource-efficient alternatives to traditional 3PDA architectures. Comparative evaluation shows that the 3PDA attains higher accuracy but only for a narrow subset of object geometries and at substantially higher computational cost due to its reliance on TDA and the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D datasets. In contrast, the 2PDA algorithm yields slightly lower accuracy but offers an order of magnitude reduction in time complexity and generalizes across a far broader range of object categories.

</details>


### [158] [RMR-Net: Degradation-Evidence-Guided Road-Image Restoration for Defect Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08957)
*Amir Ghorbani,Amirali K. Gostar,WeiQin Chuah,Vahid Ghorbani,Aidan Blair,Alireza Bab-Hadiashar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RMR-Net，一个紧凑的任务感知图像恢复前端模型，用于修复车载道路相机图像中的运动模糊、散焦、光照不足和噪声等问题，从而提升道路缺陷检测器的性能。在IVCNZ和PCM数据集上，RMR-Net在八种保留退化条件下的七种中获得最高mAP50。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载道路相机容易受到运动模糊、散焦、光照不足和噪声等退化影响，这些会抹除细小裂缝和坑洼边界等关键缺陷特征，从而严重影响道路缺陷检测器的性能。需要一种高效的任务感知恢复方法来增强退化图像中的高频路面细节。

Method: RMR-Net包含四个关键组件：(1)从图像估计退化证据；(2)可选融合现有退化上下文/参数；(3)条件化轻量级恢复块；(4)通过有界残差路径返回高频路面细节。实验中使用保存的合成生成器参数而非实测车辆遥测数据作为条件信息，并使用干净训练、冻结的YOLO11s检测器进行评估。

Result: 在八种保留退化条件下，RMR-Net在七种中获得最高mAP50。具体表现为：IVCNZ运动模糊条件下mAP50为0.140-0.427，PCM散焦条件下mAP50为0.060-0.233。消融实验表明有界细节路径是最大的局部贡献者。

Conclusion: RMR-Net作为紧凑的任务感知恢复前端，能有效提升道路缺陷检测器在退化条件下的性能。有界细节路径贡献最大，退化条件化和检测器感知的稳定性项提供互补的引导作用，证明了该方法在道路缺陷检测中的实用价值。

Abstract: Vehicle-mounted road cameras are vulnerable to motion blur, defocus, poor illumination, and noise, which can erase thin cracks and pothole boundaries needed by road defect detectors. This paper presents RMR-Net, a compact task-aware restoration front end that estimates degradation evidence from the image, optionally fuses it with existing corruption context/parameters, conditions lightweight restoration blocks, and returns high-frequency pavement detail through a bounded residual path. The experimental scope is deliberately controlled: the conditioning information used on the Image and Vision Computing New Zealand (IVCNZ) pothole dataset and the Road Damage Dataset: Potholes, Cracks and Manholes (PCM) consists of saved synthetic-generator parameters, not measured vehicle telemetry. A clean-trained, frozen YOLO11s detector evaluates every image source. Across eight held-out degradation conditions, RMR-Net obtains the highest mAP50 in seven, including 0.140-0.427 for IVCNZ motion blur and 0.060-0.233 for PCM defocus. A compact ablation identifies the bounded detail path as the largest local contributor, while degradation conditioning and detector-aware stability terms provide complementary guidance.

</details>


### [159] [Fourier Self-Supervision for Fine-Grained Generalized Category Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08963)
*Sarah Rastegar,Mina Ghadimi Atigh,Pascal Mettes,Yuki M. Asano,Cees G. M. Snoek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Fourier Self-Supervision（傅里叶自监督）方法，通过图像傅里叶变换的双频滤波策略（低频提取抽象类别属性，高频强调边缘纹理等细粒度细节）来增强广义类别发现（GCD）中细粒度区分能力，在多个细粒度数据集上超越了现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有广义类别发现方法通常基于自监督和对比学习，难以捕捉细粒度差异，过度依赖表面视觉线索而非人类分类所使用的内在属性。

Method: 提出傅里叶自监督方法，采用双频滤波策略：低频滤波器提取广泛抽象属性以捕获高层类别信息，高频滤波器强调边缘纹理等细粒度细节；每个滤波器在专用潜在空间上操作，其重叠表示共同形成更丰富完整的特征空间。

Result: 在多个细粒度数据集上的实验表明，即使类别数量未知，该方法仍优于最先进的现有方法，证明了其在广义类别发现中的有效性。

Conclusion: 双频傅里叶自监督方法不仅能细化特征提取以识别新类别，还能增强模型在细粒度类别发现中的判别能力。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery aims to recognize known categories while identifying novel ones within unlabeled data. Existing methods, typically based on self-supervision and contrastive learning, often struggle to capture fine-grained distinctions, relying on superficial visual cues rather than the intrinsic attributes humans use for categorization. We introduce Fourier Self-Supervision, that leverages the Fourier transform of images to enhance the discrimination of subtle differences and support the discovery of new categories. Our method employs a dual frequency filtering strategy: a low-pass filter first extracts broad, abstract attributes that capture high-level category information, while a high-pass filter emphasizes fine details such as edges and textures that are essential for fine-grained recognition. Each operates on a dedicated latent space, and their overlapping representations together yield a richer, more complete feature space. This dual-frequency approach not only refines feature extraction to identify novel categories, but also strengthens the model's discriminative power in fine-grained category discovery. Experiments on multiple fine-grained datasets show that incorporating Fourier Self-Supervision outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when the number of classes is unknown, demonstrating its effectiveness for Generalized Category Discovery. Our code is available at: https://github.com/SarahRastegar/FourEx.

</details>


### [160] [Detecting Clear Contact Lenses for Iris Recognition: A Two-Stage Mask-Guided Attention Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08977)
*Parisa Farmanifard,Arun Ross*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了透明隐形眼镜对虹膜识别的影响与检测问题。不同于已广泛研究的装饰性花纹镜片，透明镜片缺乏显著纹理伪影，检测难度大且以往被认为不影响识别。作者首先用VeriEye匹配器验证了透明镜片确实会降低匹配分数并增加验证误差，随后提出两阶段检测框架：第一阶段用现有PAD模型识别花纹镜片，第二阶段用配备Mask-Guided Spatial Attention（MGSA）的ConvNeXt-Base模型区分透明镜片与无镜片。在四个数据集上达到90.0%-98.8%的准确率，并引入z-score校准方法将EER降低4.1%-28.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明处方隐形眼镜使用广泛，但以往研究多聚焦于装饰性花纹镜片的PAD检测，对透明镜片关注不足。透明镜片不产生明显纹理伪影，难以检测，且常被默认对虹膜识别无影响，这一假设需要验证与突破。

Method: 提出两阶段接触镜检测框架：阶段一使用现有PAD模型识别花纹镜片；阶段二使用ConvNeXt-Base模型配合Mask-Guided Spatial Attention（MGSA）模块进行透明镜片与无镜片分类。MGSA融合Hough变换衍生的解剖ROI掩码、学习型空间注意力以及Squeeze-and-Excitation通道重标定，使网络聚焦与透明镜片佩戴相关的细微角巩膜缘线索。此外引入z-score校准方法调整VeriEye匹配分数。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上，完整流水线（花纹镜片+透明镜片检测）准确率达90.0%-98.8%。z-score校准方法在不同数据集上将EER降低4.1%-28.3%，验证了可靠透明镜片检测能直接提升虹膜验证性能。

Conclusion: 澄清了透明镜片对虹膜识别确有负面影响的假设，证明透明镜片检测对虹膜识别系统的可靠性与安全性至关重要。提出的MGSA方法及其校准策略能有效提升端到端的虹膜验证性能，为该领域提供了可行且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: This work focuses on the impact and detection of clear contact lenses in the context of iris recognition. While the detection of cosmetic or patterned contact lenses has been extensively studied under the presentation attack detection (PAD) paradigm, clear prescription contact lenses, that are typically transparent, have received comparatively less attention despite their widespread use. Unlike patterned lenses, clear lenses introduce no salient texture artifact, making them difficult to detect and are often assumed to have no impact on iris recognition. We first examine this assumption using the commercial VeriEye matcher on four benchmark datasets and show that clear lenses marginally degrade genuine match scores and increase verification error. We then propose a two-stage contact-lens detection framework. Stage~1 uses an existing PAD model to identify patterned lenses, while Stage~2 focuses on the more challenging clear-lens versus no-lens distinction using a ConvNeXt-Base model equipped with Mask-Guided Spatial Attention (MGSA). The proposed MGSA module incorporates a Hough-derived anatomical ROI mask together with learned spatial attention and Squeeze-and-Excitation channel recalibration, allowing the network to focus on subtle limbal cues associated with clear lens wear. Across four datasets, the full pipeline consisting of both patterned and clear contact lens detection achieves between 90.0\%--98.8\% accuracy. Finally, we introduce a z-score calibration method that adjusts VeriEye match scores when a clear lens is detected in the input images. This calibration reduces EER by 4.1\%--28.3\% across datasets, demonstrating that reliable clear contact lens detection can directly improve iris verification performance.

</details>


### [161] [DeepFreqMark: End-To-End Learnable Frequency-Domain Watermarking with Spherical Attack Simulation for Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08999)
*Chen-Hsiu Huang,Mario Köppen,Ja-Ling Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeepFreqMark是一个端到端可学习的频域水印框架，用于潜扩散模型（LDMs）生成的AI图像水印嵌入。它用神经网络消息编码器和解码器替代了传统的手工几何图案设计，并引入基于球形线性插值（Slerp）的攻击模拟方法，避免训练过程中昂贵的DDIM反演计算。实验表明该方法在真实攻击下显著降低了比特错误率（BER），并支持高达256比特的消息容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成图像的普及引发了版权侵权和虚假信息等严重问题。现有基于频域的水印方法虽然将手工设计的几何图案嵌入初始潜噪声中，但存在嵌入容量有限和图案设计僵化的缺点，难以满足日益增长的水印鲁棒性和灵活性需求。

Method: 提出DeepFreqMark框架，主要包含：(1) 用神经网络消息编码器和解码器替代手工图案设计，实现端到端可学习的频域水印嵌入；(2) 引入Slerp（球形线性插值）基础的攻击模拟策略，直接在噪声潜向量上操作，同时严格保持高斯方差，从而规避DDIM反演带来的计算瓶颈。

Result: 大量实验表明，DeepFreqMark在真实世界攻击下相比基线方法获得了显著更低的比特错误率（BER），并且能够扩展到256比特的消息容量，展现了更强的鲁棒性和嵌入能力。

Conclusion: DeepFreqMark通过端到端学习和创新的Slerp攻击模拟方法，有效解决了传统频域水印方法在容量和设计灵活性上的局限，为AI生成图像的版权保护和溯源提供了更可靠的解决方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: The proliferation of AI-generated images produced by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) has raised critical concerns regarding copyright infringement and misinformation. Although existing frequency-domain watermarking methods embed handcrafted geometric patterns into the initial latent noise prior to generation, they suffer from limited capacity and rigid pattern designs. We propose DeepFreqMark, an end-to-end learnable frequency-domain watermarking framework that replaces manual pattern engineering with a neural message encoder and decoder. To circumvent the computational bottleneck caused by Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) inversion during training, we introduce a Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp)-based attack simulation. This approach operates directly on the noise latent while strictly preserving the Gaussian variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepFreqMark achieves significantly lower Bit Error Rates (BER) than baseline methods under real-world attacks and scales to 256 bits message capacity. Our source code is available at https://github.com/chenhsiu48/DeepFreqMark.

</details>


### [162] [SignLlama: Enhancing Gloss-free Sign Language Translation by Prioritizing Visual Features for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09006)
*Shiwei Gan,Xiao Liu,Yafeng Yin,Zhiwei Jiang,Bowen Guo,Lie Xie,Sanglu Lu,Hongkai Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SignLlama，一个针对无词汇表手语翻译（GFSLT）任务的大语言模型适配方法。通过Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC预训练和Visual-Prioritized蒸馏训练策略，解决了视觉-文本特征分布差异和模型过度依赖文本输入这两个关键问题，在多个数据集上取得了极具竞争力的性能，且无需额外模态或外部手语数据集预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽然在广泛任务上表现优异，但将其微调应用于无词汇表手语翻译（GFSLT）仍面临挑战。作者识别出两个核心问题：(1)视觉特征与文本特征之间存在固有的分布差异，使LLM难以理解视觉输入；(2)现有的自回归框架中视觉和文本特征简单拼接会导致模型过度强调文本输入而忽视视觉线索，因为LLM主要在文本数据上预训练。

Method: 提出两种方法解决上述挑战：(1)Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining——利用从文本序列生成的过滤伪词汇表序列来监督视觉骨干网络的训练；(2)Visual-Prioritized Distillation训练策略——定义一条仅依赖视觉输入的推理路径（遮掩文本输入），并将标准视觉-文本推理路径的输出蒸馏到该视觉优先路径中，促使模型优先处理视觉特征。

Result: SignLlama在多个GFSLT数据集上取得了极具竞争力的性能，实验和定性分析证明了所提出方法的有效性，且无需使用任何额外模态或外部手语数据集进行预训练。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地解决了LLM适配GFSLT任务的两大关键障碍，提出的SignLlama通过过滤伪词汇CTC预训练弥合视觉-文本分布差距，并通过视觉优先蒸馏训练重塑模型对视觉输入的关注度，在无额外数据条件下实现了优异的翻译性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of tasks. However, fine-tuning LLMs for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation (GFSLT) remains a challenge. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively adapt LLMs to the GFSLT task. We show that there are two key issues that need to be solved: (1) the inherent distributional gap between visual feature inputs and text feature inputs makes it difficult for LLMs to interpret visual inputs; and (2) existing approaches typically concatenate visual and textual features in an autoregressive framework, which leads to the model overemphasizing textual inputs and deprioritizing visual cues, as LLMs are pretrained predominantly on text-centric data. To address the first challenge, we propose a simple yet effective method named Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining, which leverages filtered pseudo-gloss sequences generated from text sequences to supervise the training of the visual backbone. To tackle the second issue, we introduce a Visual-Prioritized Distillation training strategy. Specifically, we define a visual-only prediction path in which text inputs are masked, and the model is required to generate the target sequence relying solely on visual inputs. To guide this path, the outputs from the standard visual-textual prediction are then distilled into the visual-only prediction path, encouraging the model to prioritize visual features. Comprehensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. The proposed SignLlama achieves very competitive performance on multiple datasets for GFSLT tasks, without using any extra modalities or external sign language datasets for pretraining.

</details>


### [163] [GeoAI-based post-segmentation quality validation of building footprints via spatial feature engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09048)
*Shah Imran Ahsan Chowdhury,Kazi Jihadur Rashid,Rajsree Das Tuli,Rahul Saha,Bulbul Ahammad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多领域GeoAI质量控制框架，用于自动检测和修正深度学习建筑物足迹提取中产生的拓扑不一致矢量数据。该框架在孟加拉国五个UAV调查场地中结合U-Net和SAM-LoRA生成候选足迹，通过24个预测因子和机器学习分类器（最佳为决策树）实现对象级错误检测，在独立测试集上达到95.31%的准确率，将数据库残余错误比例从27.32%降至4.62%，纯度提升至95.38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习提取的建筑物足迹常产生拓扑不一致的矢量数据，无法直接用于GIS数据库入库，亟需自动化的质量控制系统来净化矢量足迹数据库。

Method: 采用U-Net(ResNet-34)和SAM-LoRA(ViT-B)生成候选足迹，经矢量化、几何正则化和空间互斥约束合并后，利用24个预测因子（涵盖几何、空间上下文、光谱和纹理特征），在开发集上训练ML分类器并在空间独立的测试集上进行验证。

Result: 决策树分类器表现最佳，准确率95.31%，F1值91.06%，MCC为0.880；框架成功识别87.34%的错误足迹，同时保留98.31%的可接受结构，将残余错误比例从27.32%降至4.62%，数据库纯度达95.38%，相对错误减少83.09%。

Conclusion: 分割后基于对象级的ML方法为生产级GIS工作流提供了高度可迁移、稳健的自动化质量保障机制。

Abstract: Deep learning-based building footprint extraction from high-resolution imagery often produces topologically inconsistent vectors unfit for direct GIS database ingestion. To address this, we present a multidomain GeoAI quality control framework that automates error detection to systematically purify vector footprint databases. Candidate footprints were generated across five UAV survey sites in Bangladesh using U-Net (ResNet-34) and SAM-LoRA (ViT-B). The extracted raster masks were vectorized, geometrically regularized, and consolidated under a spatial-exclusivity constraint to eliminate duplicate representations. We used twenty-four predictors capturing geometric, spatial-contextual, and raster-derived spectral and texture properties. Machine Learning (ML) classifiers were trained on a development partition (Sites B-D) and rigorously validated on a spatially independent test set (Site E) excluded from hyperparameter tuning and class balancing. The experimental results demonstrate that geometric and spatial-contextual predictors using Decision Tree (DT) provide the most effective discriminatory evidence for identifying object-level boundary deformations. DT achieved an accuracy of 95.31%, an F1-score of 91.06%, and a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.880 on the unseen testing site. At the database level, this framework successfully identified 87.34% of erroneous footprints while maintaining 98.31% of acceptable structures, reducing the residual error proportion from 27.32% to 4.62% and improving final database purity to 95.38%. This translates into a relative error reduction of 83.09%. The findings indicate that post-segmentation object-level ML provides a highly transferable, robust mechanism for automated quality assurance in production-ready geographic information system (GIS) workflows.

</details>


### [164] [Triple Expert Learning from Noisy Labels for Semi-Supervised Vision Foundation Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09052)
*Xuanyu Liu,Zheng Fang,Hongyang He,Yundi Hong,Daizong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TriNoL提出了一种三重专家学习框架，用于半监督视觉基础模型（VFM）适应。该方法将未标注样本按伪标签置信度分为三个区域，分别分配给三个LoRA专家（正样本专家、对齐专家、负样本专家）处理，以缓解伪标签噪声对模型适应的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的半监督VFM适应方法通常冻结骨干网络并更新LoRA等轻量模块，但伪标签可靠性参差不齐，单一LoRA适配器需要在同一低秩空间中吸收可靠、模糊和含噪的梯度，导致对伪标签噪声过于敏感。

Method: TriNoL将所有未标注样本根据置信度划分为三个区域，分别路由到三个LoRA专家：高置信度样本交给正样本专家（Positive Expert），中等置信度样本交给对齐专家（Alignment Expert），低置信度样本交给负样本专家（Negative Expert）。VFM骨干保持冻结，仅更新LoRA专家和分类头。

Result: 通过将不同伪标签可靠性区域分离到专门的适应路径中，TriNoL提升了对噪声监督的鲁棒性，同时保持了较低的训练成本。

Conclusion: TriNoL通过专业化分工的LoRA专家机制，有效解决了半监督VFM适应中伪标签噪声干扰的问题，为半监督视觉适应提供了一种低成本且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Semi-supervised adaptation of vision foundation models (VFMs) commonly freezes the pretrained backbone and updates lightweight modules such as LoRA. However, pseudo-labels have mixed reliability, and a single LoRA adapter must absorb reliable, ambiguous, and noisy gradients in the same low-rank space. This can make VFM adaptation sensitive to pseudo-label noise. We propose \textbf{TriNoL}, a \textbf{Tri}ple-expert learning framework from \textbf{No}isy \textbf{L}abels for semi-supervised VFM adaptation. TriNoL routes unlabeled samples into three confidence regions and assigns them to three LoRA experts: a Positive Expert for high-confidence pseudo-labels, an Alignment Expert for medium-confidence ambiguous samples, and a Negative Expert for low-confidence noisy samples. The VFM backbone remains frozen, and only the LoRA experts and classifier head are updated. By separating different pseudo-label reliability regions into specialized adaptation paths, TriNoL improves robustness to noisy supervision while keeping the training cost low.

</details>


### [165] [Model the Edit, Not the Image: Visual Autoregressive Editing from a Source-Centric Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09057)
*Hongyi Fang,Chuwen Xie,Benjia Zhou,Yu-Xuan Qiu,Chenggong Hu,Zhibin Wang,Chao Chen,Jianbin Qin,Rui Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EditMod，一种基于源中心视角的视觉自回归模型（VAR）文本引导图像编辑方法。该方法在共享自回归上下文中比较源条件与目标条件的预测，将其差异作为尺度级编辑方向，并对源token进行残差更新。EditMod在保持强文本对齐的同时实现领先的源图像保真度，在单张A100 GPU上完成1K图像端到端编辑仅需1.57秒，无需逐图像预处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管VAR模型在图像生成中表现出色，但其在文本引导图像编辑方面的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。现有的免训练VAR编辑方法采用生成中心的视角，将编辑视为由源图像引导或约束的目标条件再生成，可能依赖反转、测试时优化、注意力控制或用户掩码，未能充分利用VAR提供的多尺度源表示，且引入额外计算或人工干预。

Method: EditMod采用源中心视角，将编码后的源图像token作为主要视觉状态，编辑过程聚焦于条件引发的变化。具体而言，它在共享自回归上下文中比较源条件和目标条件的预测，将两者的差异视为尺度级的编辑方向，并作为残差更新应用到选定尺度的源token上。

Result: 实验表明，EditMod在源图像保真度上达到领先水平，同时保持强文本对齐。在单张A100 GPU上，1K图像的端到端编辑仅需1.57秒，且无需逐图像准备。

Conclusion: EditMod通过从生成中心转向源中心的编辑范式，更充分地利用了VAR的多尺度源表示，实现了高效、高保真且无需额外干预的文本引导图像编辑，为VAR在编辑任务中的应用提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Next-scale visual autoregressive models (VARs) have emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, producing high-quality images through efficient coarse-to-fine prediction. However, their potential for text-guided image editing remains largely underexplored. Existing training-free VAR editing approaches often formulate editing as target-conditioned regeneration guided or constrained by the source image, and may rely on inversion, test-time optimization, attention control, or user-provided masks. This generation-centric formulation does not fully exploit the multiscale source representations provided by VARs and may introduce additional computation or intervention. We instead take a source-centric perspective on VAR editing, in which the encoded source image tokens serve as the primary visual state and the editing process focuses on condition-induced changes. Based on this perspective, we propose \textbf{EditMod}, which compares source- and target-conditioned predictions under a shared autoregressive context, treats their difference as a scale-wise editing direction, and applies it as a residual update to source tokens at selected scales. Experiments show that EditMod achieves leading source-image fidelity while maintaining strong text alignment, and completes end-to-end editing of a 1K image in only 1.57 seconds on a single A100 GPU without per-image preparation.

</details>


### [166] [Learning human joint torques from pixels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09083)
*Chen Chen,Rui Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VID，一个基于视觉的逆动力学数据集和基准，用于从真实单目图像直接预测人体关节力矩。VID包含63,369帧同步数据，涵盖真实人体图像、运动学标注、人体测量属性和OpenSim导出的动力学标签。作者还提出VID-Network模型，结合姿态预训练的空间概率特征、标记点回归和时间力矩推断，在整体mPJE指标上达到1.7612 N·m/kg，比最佳基线提升39.81%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人体关节力矩估计方法依赖表面肌电图、动捕标记点、力板或模拟数据，无法直接应用于普通RGB图像，限制了生物力学分析从受控实验室走向真实世界场景。作者希望通过构建视觉驱动的逆动力学数据集和基准，使关节力矩估计能够直接基于单目图像进行，从而在非受控环境中实现生物力学推断。

Method: 作者首先构建了VID数据集，包含63,369帧同步的真实人体图像、运动学标注、人体测量属性和OpenSim派生的动力学标签，提供配对视觉与生物力学监督。其次定义了标准化评估协议，涵盖整体力矩估计、关节特定分析和动作特定预测。最后提出VID-Network模型，采用姿态预训练的空间概率特征提取、标记点回归和时间力矩推断三阶段架构，从图像序列中恢复关节力矩。

Result: 在VID数据集上的实验表明，VID-Network达到整体mPJE为1.7612 N·m/kg，相比最佳对比基线提升39.81%；在所有评估的关节类型和大多数动作类别中均取得最低误差。

Conclusion: VID建立了第一个实用的视觉驱动人体逆动力学基准，为在较少受约束的环境中研究生物力学推断提供了基础，推动了从实验室到真实世界场景的生物力学分析应用。

Abstract: Estimating human joint torques from visual observations is a key step toward bringing biomechanical analysis from controlled laboratories to real-world movement scenarios. Existing torque estimation methods typically depend on surface electromyography, motion-capture markers, force plates, or simulated imitation data, which limits their applicability to ordinary RGB images. In this work, we introduce VID, a vision-based inverse dynamics dataset and benchmark for predicting human joint torques directly from real monocular images. VID contains 63,369 synchronized frames with real human images, kinematic annotations, anthropometric attributes, and OpenSim-derived dynamic labels, providing paired visual and biomechanical supervision for real-image inverse dynamics. We further define a standardized evaluation protocol covering overall torque estimation, joint-specific analysis, and action-specific prediction. To establish a strong reference model, we propose VID-Network, which combines pose-pretrained spatial probabilistic features, marker regression, and temporal torque inference to recover joint torques from image sequences. Experiments on VID show that VID-Network achieves an overall mPJE of 1.7612 N$\cdot$m/kg, improving over the best compared baseline by 39.81\%, and obtains the lowest error across all evaluated joint types and most action categories. VID establishes a first practical benchmark for vision-driven human inverse dynamics and provides a foundation for studying biomechanical inference in less constrained environments.

</details>


### [167] [TLDChoiceNet: Quantitatively Choosing a Transfer Learning Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09091)
*Jing Ning,James D. Braza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TLDChoiceNet模型，用于在给定微调数据集时自动选择最佳迁移学习数据集。简单版本MSE为0.154，基于ImageNet预训练ResNet50 v2嵌入的版本MSE降低5倍至0.031。同时提出两个无监督指标：分布距离（DD，R²=0.89）和平均类相关性（ACC，R²=0.97），用于选择最优迁移学习数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迁移学习通常凭经验选择ImageNet、CIFAR-100等大规模数据集，但缺乏定量方法来确定哪个迁移学习数据集对特定微调任务最优。虽然直觉上迁移数据集应有更多类别和每类更多样本，但没有量化选择标准。

Method: 设计TLDChoiceNet模型预测微调后的测试集准确率来选择最优迁移学习数据集。版本1为简单预测模型；版本2利用ImageNet预训练ResNet50 v2嵌入并结合每类信息。此外设计了两个无监督指标：分布距离（DD）和平均类相关性（ACC），通过线性回归与微调准确率建立关联。

Result: 版本1达到0.154 MSE，版本2达到0.031 MSE（降低5倍）。DD指标线性回归R²为0.89，ACC指标将R²提升至0.97，二者均能较好地预测微调准确率。

Conclusion: 数据集的低层统计特征可以解释迁移学习效果，且使用ImageNet预训练可将不同类别在潜在特征空间中嵌入得更远，从而提升迁移学习效果。

Abstract: Transfer learning is particularly useful in settings with limited training data, and within image classification it is common to transfer learn upon massive datasets like ImageNet , CIFAR-100, or COCO . Qualitatively, it seems a transfer learning dataset should have both more classes and more examples per class than the fine tuning dataset; however, a quantitative method to choose the best transfer learning dataset does not currently exist. In this paper, we design TLDChoiceNet, a model to choose the best transfer learning dataset given a fine tuning dataset by predicting the test-set accuracy after fine-tuning. A simple version 1 achieves 0.154 MSE on the test dataset, while a version 2 leveraging an ImageNet pre-trained ResNet50 v2 embedding with per-class information attains a 5X lower MSE of 0.031. We further design two metrics that enable an unsupervised method of choosing an optimal transfer learning dataset: distribution distance (DD), which linearly regresses against fine-tune accuracy with an R2 of 0.89, and average class correlation (ACC), which improves the R2 to 0.97. Our results underscore that a dataset's low-level statistics can explain the transfer learning effect, and that using a pre-trained ImageNet can embed different classes further apart in latent feature space.

</details>


### [168] [SI-Edit: Toward Sketch-Instruction Guided Local Image Editing with Pixel-Level Precision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09097)
*Weixin Ye,Wei Wang,Hongguang Zhu,Xuecheng Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SI-Data高质量数据集和SI-Edit协作框架，用于解决基于草图的图像编辑中像素级精度不足的问题。SI-Data通过多模态大语言模型自动生成包含原图、局部几何草图、语义指令和编辑后图像的四元组数据；SI-Edit框架将语义指令与精确几何约束协同整合，并建立了同时评估结构保真度和语义一致性的标准化指标，实验证明其在结构控制和像素级局部细化方面优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于草图的图像编辑在像素级精度尤其是细粒度局部形变方面仍面临持续挑战，根本原因是缺乏同时提供几何约束和语义指令的高质量公开基准数据集。

Method: 首先提出SI-Data数据集构建管线，利用多模态大语言模型自动合成包含原始图像、局部几何草图、语义指令和对应编辑图像的四元组；在此基础上提出SI-Edit协作框架，将语义指令与精确几何约束集成；同时建立包含结构保真度（如草图到边缘对齐）和语义一致性两方面的综合评价指标体系。

Result: 实验结果表明，SI-Edit在基于草图的图像编辑中提供了比基线方法更可靠的结构控制，实现了与用户意图一致的精确像素级局部细化。

Conclusion: 通过高质量数据集与协作框架的结合，本文有效解决了草图编辑中几何与语义联合约束的难题，为空间-语义协同学习提供了新的解决方案，相关数据和代码已公开。

Abstract: Despite rapid advances in generative models, achieving pixel-level precision in sketch-based image editing remains a persistent challenge, particularly for fine-grained local deformations. This gap stems primarily from the critical shortage of high-quality, publicly available benchmark datasets that jointly provide geometric constraints and semantic instructions. To address this issue, we first introduce **SI-Data**, a high-quality dataset specifically designed for instruction-guided local sketch editing. We develop an automated pipeline leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to synthesize comprehensive quadruplets comprising original images, local geometric sketches, semantic instructions, and corresponding edited images. By providing both reliable spatial anchors and explicit semantic intent, SI-Data uniquely enables collaborative spatial-semantic learning. Building upon this, we propose a collaborative framework called **SI-Edit** that integrates semantic instructions with precise geometric constraints. Furthermore, to address the lack of standardized evaluation, we establish a comprehensive set of metrics designed to measure both structural fidelity (e.g., sketch-to-edge alignment) and semantic adherence. Experimental results demonstrate that SI-Edit provides more reliable structural control than baselines for sketch-based image editing, and achieves precise, pixel-level local refinements aligned with user intent. The data and code are released on the [project page](https://github.com/ywxsuperstar/SIEdit).

</details>


### [169] [Contrastive Mask Fidelity: Reference-Free Auditing of Ground-Truth Masks in Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09101)
*Shuaishuai Cao,Shuwei Peng,Meng Tang,Min Huang,Youjin Wang,Jie Chen,Jing Ouyang,Zhiwei Zhai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出对比掩膜保真度（CMF），一种无需训练、无需参考的度量方法，直接基于图像证据对竞争的类别掩膜进行评分，用于审计遥感语义分割标注质量。通过对10个基准的10,731个图像-类别对进行审计，发现人工标注存在系统性类别依赖偏差，CMF与专家判断81%一致，并可用于改进跨域迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感分割模型的训练和评估依赖人工绘制的掩膜，但这些标注常是粗糙、不完整或错位的。当高重叠分数可能反映的是对不完美标注的认同而非对图像的忠实时，就会出现评估悖论。因此需要一种直接参考图像证据而非先验标注的度量方法来审计标注质量。

Method: CMF通过对每个掩膜构建"保留"和"擦除"的反事实视图，使用冻结的视觉-语言模型判断类别证据是否集中在掩膜内部且外部缺失。在受控掩膜腐蚀实验中验证后，使用基于SegEarth-OV3的Seg-Probe生成候选掩膜，在10个遥感基准上审计10,731对图-类别样本。

Result: CMF在9/10数据集上超越先前基线；审计揭示类别依赖的标注失真，人造类别（建筑物、道路、汽车）在62-85%的样本中倾向候选掩膜，而模糊土地覆盖更倾向人工标注。在盲测三方共识中，CMF与专家判断81%一致，超过仅保留评分、模型置信度和训练标签质量基线。基于CMF的类别级仲裁提高了跨域迁移效果。

Conclusion: CMF可作为大规模审计地真标注的可扩展工具，不假设标注绝对正确，而是用图像证据检验标注质量。保守的类别级仲裁可改善监督信号并促进跨域迁移，挑战了以人类标注为金标准的传统范式。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation models are trained and evaluated against human-drawn masks, yet remote-sensing annotations are often coarse, incomplete, or misaligned; high overlap scores may then reflect agreement with imperfect labels rather than faithfulness to the image, creating an evaluation paradox. We introduce Contrastive Mask Fidelity (CMF), a training-free, reference-free metric that scores competing class masks directly against image evidence. CMF composites keep and erase counterfactual views of each mask and asks a frozen vision-language judge whether class evidence is concentrated inside the mask and absent outside. We validate CMF on controlled mask corruptions, then audit 10,731 image-class pairs across ten remote-sensing benchmarks using candidate masks from Seg-Probe, a training-free open-vocabulary probe built on SegEarth-OV3 that outperforms prior baselines on nine of ten datasets. The audit reveals systematic, class-dependent annotation distortion: man-made classes such as buildings, roads, and cars favor the candidate mask on 62-85% of pairs, whereas ambiguous land cover more often favors human annotations. On a blinded three-annotator consensus, CMF matches expert judgment on 81% of pairs, exceeding keep-only scoring, model confidence, and a trained label-quality baseline. Finally, conservative class-wise arbitration yields supervision that improves cross-domain transfer over raw annotations and matched replacement controls, positioning CMF as a scalable tool for auditing ground truth rather than presuming it infallible.

</details>


### [170] [View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09110)
*U-Chae Jun,Jaeeun Ko,Jiwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种视角自适应的神经渲染框架，用于从单张图像进行3D重建，即使面对部分不一致的多视角输入也能保持鲁棒性。该方法通过视角自适应神经渲染器独立修正视角相关误差，同时共享全局特征骨干网络保持结构一致性，并引入自注意力融合模块自适应整合多视角信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的单目3D生成流程通常先合成多视角图像再基于NeRF重建，但固有的投影歧义会导致生成视角间出现视觉不连续，造成重建误差。现有解决方案要么计算开销大，要么无法充分解决合成视角间的实际不一致问题。

Method: 提出三个关键组件：(1) 视角自适应神经渲染器，独立修正视角相关误差；(2) 全局特征骨干网络，用于共享信息保持结构一致性；(3) 自注意力融合模块，自适应整合多视角信息以确保几何一致性，无需依赖间接正则化或高计算量方法。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法持续提升了3D重建保真度，在不依赖基于扩散的SDS监督的情况下，仅依靠光度渲染损失配合轻量注意力正则化即可达到接近最先进水平的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法在准确性和效率之间取得了良好平衡，使框架具有较高的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinuities across generated viewpoints, leading to inaccuracies in reconstructed 3D models. Current solutions either incur significant additional computational burdens or fail to adequately resolve practical inconsistencies between synthesized views. To address these limitations, we propose a novel viewpoint-adaptive neural rendering framework that enables robust 3D reconstruction even when given partially inconsistent multi-view inputs. Our approach introduces view-adaptive neural renderers that independently correct viewpoint-dependent errors while simultaneously sharing a global feature backbone to preserve structural coherence. Furthermore, we propose a self-attention fusion module that adaptively integrates multi-view information, ensuring geometric consistency without relying heavily on indirect regularizations or computationally intensive methods. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method consistently improves 3D reconstruction fidelity. Importantly, our approach achieves near state-of-the-art performance without diffusion-based SDS supervision, relying primarily on photometric rendering loss with lightweight attention regularizers. This balance between accuracy and efficiency makes the proposed framework highly practical for real-world applications.

</details>


### [171] [Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09122)
*Ziheng Jia,Yingji Liang,Jiaying Qian,Xiongkuo Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VIGIL，一种基于大语言模型架构的图像质量评估方法，通过构建140K训练集和多层LLM解码器作为多检测器进行同步失真检测，有效解决了合成到真实场景的泛化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LMM的图像质量评估方法主要依赖文本驱动的监督微调，存在检测精度不足的问题；同时合成失真图像与真实场景之间存在显著的泛化差距（S2A问题），迫切需要更精确的视觉失真检测方法。

Method: 从超过1000K候选样本中构建VIGIL-140K训练集（含140K+失真图像，覆盖8类合成失真），利用LLM解码器不同层作为多个检测器进行多层级特征的同步失真检测，并保留非失真类预测中的失真线索以缓解前景-背景分离模糊问题。

Result: 在域内合成失真检测和S2A任务上，VIGIL持续优于强基线方法，展现出更优的检测精度和跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: VIGIL通过创新的训练数据构建和多层检测器机制，有效解决了LMM在IQA中检测精度不足和S2A泛化差距的问题。

Abstract: The localized depiction of perceptual quality has long been a crucial, yet underexplored, challenge in image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches based on large multimodal models (LMMs) predominantly rely on text-driven supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  However, this training paradigm exhibits notable limitations in detection accuracy. Moreover, synthetically distorted images, which are often used as the primary training data source,
  show a significant generalization gap when deployed in real-world scenarios; thus, the \textbf{synthetic-to-authentic (\textit{S2A})} problem represents a critical challenge. Motivated by these issues, we propose \textbf{\textit{VIGIL}}, which leverages the LMM architecture for precise visual distortion detection. From a candidate pool of over 1000K samples, we construct the \textbf{\textit{VIGIL-140K}} training set, which consists of over 140K distorted images. These images are obtained through rigorous quality filtering and carefully crafted distortion injection, covering 8 major synthetic distortion categories.
  Our model leverages different layers of the large language model (LLM) decoder, treating them as \textit{multiple detectors} that perform synchronous distortion detection using multi-level features. Additionally, we retain distortion cues from predictions assigned to the non-distortion class, which helps mitigate the ambiguous foreground-background (\textit{FG-BG}) separation commonly encountered in the \textit{S2A} problem.
  After post-processing, our model consistently outperforms strong baselines on both in-domain synthetic distortion detection and \textit{S2A} tasks.

</details>


### [172] [When Latents Forget Pixels: Restoring Fidelity in Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09133)
*Yu Shi,Yuyao Zhang,Yu-wing Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出像素接地超分辨率（PGSR）框架，通过在VAE压缩前提取LR像素证据并在条件侧和译码器侧复用，解决扩散Transformer在生成式超分辨率中因VAE瓶颈导致的幻觉细节问题，同时保持模型主干冻结，仅训练轻量级恢复模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大型生成模型的图像超分辨率虽已实现卓越感知质量，但保持与低分辨率观测的保真度仍是挑战。扩散Transformer依赖的VAE潜在表示存在压缩瓶颈，削弱了细粒度空间信息，导致产生与输入图像关联薄弱的幻觉细节。

Method: 提出PGSR框架：(1) 在VAE压缩前从放大的LR图像提取像素证据；(2) 通过条件侧轨迹引导将LR像素证据与潜在条件融合，引导潜在恢复轨迹；(3) 通过译码器侧像素接地将多尺度像素特征注入冻结的VAE译码器，接地最终渲染；(4) 保持潜在自编码器和主流程匹配骨干冻结，仅训练轻量级恢复模块，并研究高效局部窗口注意力变体以提升高分辨率效率。

Result: 大量实验表明PGSR改善了真实感与保真度之间的权衡，相较于现有潜在生成式SR方法产生更忠实、视觉上更令人信服的结果。

Conclusion: PGSR验证了从表征角度重新审视生成式超分辨率的有效性：在VAE压缩前保留并复用LR像素证据，能够在不增加显著训练成本的前提下同时提升真实感与保真度，为潜在扩散生成式SR提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) with large generative models has recently achieved remarkable perceptual quality, yet maintaining fidelity to the LR observation remains challenging. In particular, we observe that diffusion transformers (DiTs) built on latent representations suffer from a critical limitation: the compression bottleneck of the VAE weakens fine-grained spatial information, leading to hallucinated details that are weakly grounded in the input image. In this work, we revisit generative SR from a representation perspective and propose a pixel-grounded super-resolution (PGSR) framework that preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it throughout restoration. Instead of relying solely on the compressed latent condition, PGSR extracts pre-VAE pixel evidence from the upsampled LR image and reuses it at two stages. First, Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance fuses LR-derived pixel evidence with the latent LR condition to guide the latent restoration trajectory. Second, Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding injects multi-scale pixel features into the frozen VAE decoder to ground the final rendering with LR-observed cues. To efficiently adapt large pretrained DiT models, we keep the latent autoencoder and main flow-matching backbone frozen, and train only lightweight restoration modules. We further study an efficient local-window attention variant for improved high-resolution efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSR improves the realism--fidelity trade-off and produces more faithful, visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.

</details>


### [173] [Bright-Channel Retinex Enhancement with a Conditional Overdispered-Noise Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09137)
*Jongpil Jeong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种免训练的低光图像增强方法，结合局部亮通道光照估计、Retinex除法与边缘保持去噪。在LOL-v1数据集上取得17.74dB PSNR和0.739 SSIM，为传统方法中最高；在Apple M2 Pro CPU上处理400×600图像速度约43 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像增强需要同时处理光照估计、噪声放大与边缘保持等问题，传统方法缺乏系统的噪声建模，而免训练方法希望在无需数据标注的情况下实现高效且高质量的低光增强。

Method: 1）局部亮通道估计光照；2）通过Retinex除法获得反射率；3）采用条件负二项分布伪计数方法建模除法放大后的异方差噪声；4）像素级极大似然估计反射率，含零值观测的边界解；5）结合光照滤波与范围裁剪；6）最后使用固定带宽双边滤波器作为经验近似。

Result: 在LOL-v1数据集上PSNR为17.74dB、SSIM为0.739，为所有被评估的传统方法中最高；在Apple M2 Pro CPU上以约43 FPS处理400×600图像。

Conclusion: 该免训练方法在保持实时处理效率的同时，实现了优于传统方法的增强质量。NB模型作为诊断性噪声分析工具而非精确传感器模型，双边滤波为经验近似而非精确贝叶斯解，展示了实用性与理论精确性之间的权衡。

Abstract: I present a training-free low-light enhancement method that combines local bright-channel illumination estimation, Retinex division, and edge-preserving denoising. For a fixed illumination estimate, a conditional Negative -Binominal psueduo-count method characterises the heteroscedastic noise amplified by division. The unconstrained reflectance ratio is the pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimate, with a boundary solution for zero-valued observations; the implemented estimate additionally applies illumination filtering and range clipping. The NB model is a diagnostic noise analysis rather than a calibrated sensor model, and the final fixed-bandwidth bilateral filter is an empirical approximation rather than the exact Bayesian solution. On the LOL-v1 dataset, the methodobtains mean PSNR/SSIM of 17.74dB/0.739, the highest values among the evaluated with conventional methods. A 400X600 image is processed at approximately 43 FPS on an Apple M2 Pro CPU.

</details>


### [174] [CodecArena: Codec Quality Assessment via Visual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09139)
*Jiaye Fu,Weiqi Li,Qiankun Gao,Yanchen Zhao,Xiandong Meng,Jian Zhang,Siwei Ma,Jiaqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CodecArena，一个用于视频编码质量评估的视觉-语言框架，将编码器评估建模为源条件化的比较推理任务。通过Facet-GRPO强化学习方案，从身份、物体、文字、纹理和时间一致性五个保真度维度对齐编码器偏好，并在传统、神经和生成式编码器重建上构建了CodecArena-1K数据集和CodecArena-Bench基准，在源域外内容上取得了与人类判断最佳的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编码质量评估指标（如LPIPS、DISTS）主要衡量特征和纹理相似度而非内容保真度，导致重建图像即使出现错误人脸或文字模糊等问题仍可能得分较高，与人类主观判断严重不符，亟需更准确的质量评估方法。

Method: 提出CodecArena框架，将编码器评估转化为参考源条件化的成对比较推理。利用Facet-GRPO视觉强化学习方案对齐成对编码器偏好，并通过五个保真度维度（身份、物体、文字、纹理、时间一致性）锚定奖励函数，采用自动推导的维度方向作为弱锚点而非人工逐维度标注。同时构建CodecArena-1K自动偏好数据集和CodecArena-Bench人工排名基准。

Result: 大量实验表明，CodecArena在源域外内容上、跨多种编码器和码率条件下，与人类判断的一致性达到最先进水平，超越了感知指标和先前的视觉-语言评估器。

Conclusion: CodecArena证明了将视觉-语言模型与多维度保真度锚定的强化学习相结合，可以有效解决低/超低码率视频编码中的内容保真度评估问题，为生成式编码器的质量评测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Video coding is advancing into the low and ultra-low bitrate regime, driven by end-to-end codecs that replace the hand-crafted pipeline with jointly optimized neural networks and generative codecs that exploit the priors of video generation models. Yet the dominant metrics, LPIPS and DISTS, measure feature and texture similarity rather than content fidelity: a reconstruction that hallucinates a wrong face or blurs text into convincing strokes can still score well, even when a human rejects it instantly. To address this, we propose CodecArena, the first vision-language framework for video coding quality assessment, casting codec evaluation as source-conditioned comparative reasoning between a reference and its reconstructions. We optimize CodecArena with Facet-GRPO, a visual reinforcement learning scheme that aligns pairwise codec preferences while grounding the verdict in five fidelity facets: identity, objects, text, texture, and temporal consistency. Its facet-anchored reward uses automatically derived facet directions as weak anchors, rather than human per-facet labels, to prevent any single sub-score from dominating the holistic preference and to yield interpretable fine-grained quality judgments. To support training and evaluation in this underexplored regime, we construct two complementary resources: CodecArena-1K, a fully automatic preference dataset of 1,500 comparison groups built from traditional, neural, and generative codec reconstructions with fused vision-language and objective supervision; and CodecArena-Bench, a human-ranked benchmark with source-disjoint videos for fair out-of-domain evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodecArena achieves state-of-the-art agreement with human judgments on source-disjoint content across diverse codecs and bitrates, surpassing perceptual metrics and prior vision-language evaluators.

</details>


### [175] [UniMoFlow: Grounding Instruction-Driven 3D Human Motion Editing in Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09143)
*Yilei Hua,Beibei Jing,Ce Zheng,Hanyu Zhou,Yawei Luo,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一整套基于文本驱动的3D人体运动编辑框架，包括大规模数据集Omni-MoEdit、统一潜空间流匹配模型UniMoFlow以及源锚定流编辑方法SAFE，在数据、架构和推理三个层面系统性地解决了现有方法控制精度不足和训练数据稀缺的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D人体运动编辑方法要么采用训练无关的生成模型适配（控制效果欠佳），要么依赖人工标注的三元组监督（数据集规模有限、语义多样性不足）。这一瓶颈阻碍了运动编辑在时空定位精度和语义覆盖方面的提升。

Method: 在数据层面，构建了闭环合成与验证流水线，生成大规模Omni-MoEdit数据集，覆盖身体部位、幅度、时间、动作和风格五类编辑。在架构层面，提出UniMoFlow统一潜空间流匹配模型，共享生成与编辑任务间的语义和运动学知识。在推理层面，提出SAFE（源锚定流编辑）方法，在可控的源锚定精化机制下对UniMoFlow进行补充。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法在目标文本对齐、编辑有效性和循环一致性方面均有显著提升，同时保持了具有竞争力的源保真度和文生运动生成质量。

Conclusion: 通过将运动编辑直接嵌入文生运动的生成框架中，从数据、架构和推理三个层面协同优化，有效突破了数据稀缺和控制精度两大瓶颈，为3D人体运动编辑提供了更普适且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Instruction-driven editing of 3D human motion requires precise spatiotemporal localization, rich semantic grounding, and strict preservation of unmodified content. Existing methods either resort to training-free adaptation of generative models or rely solely on triplet supervision; however, adaptation often yields suboptimal control, and manually curated triplet datasets remain severely limited in scale and semantic diversity. To overcome this bottleneck, we ground motion editing directly within text-to-motion generation across data, architecture, and inference. At the data level, we develop a closed-loop synthesis-and-verification pipeline that produces Omni-MoEdit, a large-scale dataset spanning body-part, amplitude, temporal, action, and style edits. At the architectural level, we introduce UniMoFlow, a unified latent flow-matching model that shares broad semantic and kinematic knowledge between generation and editing. At the inference level, SAFE (Source-Anchored Flow Editing) complements UniMoFlow with controllable, source-anchored refinement. Furthermore, we augment standard evaluations with semantics-aware metrics to account for valid edits that inherently deviate from a single ground-truth reference. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved target-text alignment, edit effectiveness, and cycle consistency, while maintaining competitive source fidelity and text-to-motion generation quality.

</details>


### [176] [Right Answer, Wrong Heat: Explanation-Aware Evaluation and Thermal-Grounded Feedback for MLLMs on Infrared Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09145)
*Yongsong Huang,Xiaofeng Liu,Tomo Miyazaki,Yaohou Fan,Shinichiro Omachi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向红外图像的、感知解释的评价框架，将答案正确性、输出级解释接地性和热接地性分离评估。通过双LLM共识评判器和人机校准，发现正确答案可能依赖弱可见光证据；移除红外图像会侵蚀热接地性而对准确率影响很小，且该侵蚀在更强模型中更明显。提出无训练的热接地反馈（TGF）循环，在不改变答案的前提下提升解释侧接地性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）被越来越多地应用于红外图像，但现有评估仅以答案准确率衡量，正确答案不能保证模型的解释真正基于红外热证据，因此需要一种能够分离并评估解释接地性的评价框架。

Method: 提出解释感知评价框架，分离答案正确性、输出级解释接地性和热接地性三个维度；使用双LLM共识评判器（Dual-LLM Consensus Judge）并辅以人工锚定校准检查；提出Thermal-Grounded Feedback（TGF），一种无训练反馈循环，诊断解释侧失败并修订解释但保留已选答案。

Result: 发现正确答案仍可能依赖弱或可见光证据；当移除原始红外图像仅展示可见光样式渲染时，热接地性显著下降而准确率几乎不变；这种侵蚀在能力更强的模型中更为明显，但红外图像可用时该现象消失。TGF在本地配对输入验证中在不改变答案的情况下提升了解释侧接地性。

Conclusion: 未来面向红外场景理解的可信MLLM应被评估和开发为产生热接地解释，而非仅仅追求准确答案。

Abstract: General-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to infrared images, where they are commonly scored by answer accuracy alone. However, a correct answer does not ensure that the model's explanation is grounded in infrared thermal evidence. We introduce an explanation-aware evaluation framework that separates answer correctness, output-level explanation groundedness, and thermal grounding for infrared visual questions. Using a Dual-LLM Consensus Judge with a preliminary human-anchor calibration check, we find that correct answers can still rely on weak or visible-light evidence; withholding the original infrared image and showing only a visible-like rendering erodes thermal grounding with little accuracy change; and this erosion is observed most strongly for more capable models but disappears when infrared remains available. We further propose Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF), a training-free feedback loop that diagnoses explanation-side failures and revises the explanation while preserving the selected answer. On local paired-input validation, TGF improves explanation-side grounding without changing answers. These findings suggest that future trustworthy MLLMs for infrared scene understanding should be evaluated and developed to produce thermally grounded explanations rather than merely accurate answers.

</details>


### [177] [Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09146)
*Tianchen Deng,Chongdi Wang,Nailin Wang,Lei Zhao,Ziqi Ma,Tianjun Zhang,Zhe Liu,Danwei Wang,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多子地图架构和双层回环闭合机制的大规模神经SLAM系统，通过渐进式建图策略、光流跟踪模块、局部到全局回环框架及子地图间在线蒸馏算法，解决了NeRF-SLAM在大规模复杂环境中存在的灾难性遗忘和轨迹漂移问题，在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的NeRF-based SLAM方法在小规模场景重建中表现优异，但扩展到大规模复杂环境时面临两大挑战：灾难性遗忘导致的重建质量下降，以及累计轨迹漂移导致的定位精度退化。

Method: 1) 提出渐进式建图策略，动态分配神经子地图以避免内存爆炸；2) 集成基于光流的跟踪模块以应对剧烈运动；3) 设计局部到全局的双层回环闭合框架，利用基础模型提取全局描述子增强重定位精度；4) 提出子地图间在线蒸馏算法，在回环优化过程中保持重叠子地图边界上的几何与外观一致性。

Result: 在公共基准和自建的大规模室内外数据集上进行了广泛评估，并在机载计算单元上完成了直接部署验证。实验结果表明，该方法在重建质量和定位鲁棒性方面均优于现有最先进的神经SLAM方法。

Conclusion: 该方法为大场景神经SLAM提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，适用于真实机器人感知和数字孪生应用，代码将开源。

Abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based SLAM has demonstrated impressive results in small-scale scene reconstruction, yet scaling these methods to extensive, complex environments remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting and accumulated trajectory drift. This paper presents a robust, large-scale neural SLAM system featuring a multi-submap architecture and a dual-tier loop closure mechanism. Specifically, we propose a progressive mapping strategy that dynamically allocates neural submaps to maintain high-fidelity representations without memory explosion. For robust pose estimation, an optical-flow-based tracking module is integrated to handle aggressive motions. To address global consistency, we introduce a local-to-global loop closure framework leveraging the foundation model for high-performance global descriptor extraction, significantly enhancing relocalization accuracy under varying viewpoints. Furthermore, an inter-submap online distillation algorithm is designed during back-end optimization to enforce geometric and appearance consistency across overlapping submap boundaries. To validate the system, we developed a customized handheld mechatronic platform and conducted extensive evaluations on both public benchmarks and our large-scale indoor-outdoor datasets. Experimental results, including direct deployment on an onboard computing unit, demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art neural SLAM methods in reconstruction quality and localization robustness, providing a scalable solution for real-world robotic perception and digital twinning. We will release the code publicly on \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM} .

</details>


### [178] [RefineAny3D: Depth Refinement as Semantic Alignment for Monocular 3D Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09147)
*Zhihao Zhang,Gengwei Zhang,Tianlong Chen,Xiaoming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineAny3D提出了一种将单目3D物体检测中的深度精化视为独立视觉对齐任务的VLM方法，通过扩展词汇表使用动作token替代数值深度输出，在链式思维数据集上训练，作为后处理步骤可一致提升闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度基础模型虽然具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但缺乏3D检测所需的物体级精度；直接用深度基础模型替代检测器自身的深度预测反而会降低精度。作者认为不应端到端地推动检测器或深度模型更精确，而是将物体级深度精化作为独立任务来处理。

Method: 核心洞察是深度误差在图像空间中具有直接视觉特征：正确的3D框投影到图像上会紧密包围物体，太远的框投影过小，太近的框投影过大。因此将深度精化转化为视觉对齐问题而非度量回归问题。具体实现：扩展VLM词汇表，用动作token替代数值深度输出（分类决策）；在大规模链式思维数据集上训练，使模型将每个决策建立在明确的视觉证据之上。

Result: 作为单一的后处理步骤，RefineAny3D在闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具上均取得一致的性能提升，且无需重训练即可泛化到新的类别、场景和摄像头。

Conclusion: 将深度精化重新定义为视觉对齐任务而非数值回归任务，利用VLM的视觉理解能力，可以有效地弥补深度基础模型在物体级精度上的不足，为3D检测提供了一种通用的后处理精化方案。

Abstract: Monocular 3D object detection spans two regimes: closed-set detectors operating within a fixed category vocabulary, and open-vocabulary detectors that localize arbitrary categories by leveraging depth foundation models for 3D geometry. We find that current depth foundation models, despite their strong zero-shot generalization, lack the object-level precision 3D detection demands: substituting a state-of-the-art depth foundation model for a strong detector's predicted depth degrades accuracy, even falling below the detector's own prediction. Rather than pushing detectors or depth models to be more accurate end-to-end, we treat object-level depth refinement as a stand-alone task and present RefineAny3D, a vision-language model that corrects depth without ever predicting a numerical value. Our key insight is that depth error has a direct visual signature in image space: when projected onto the image, a correctly placed box tightly encloses the object, while a too-far box projects too small and a too-close box projects too large. Depth refinement thus reduces to a visual alignment problem rather than a metric regression problem, which we instantiate by extending the VLM's vocabulary with action tokens that replace numerical depth output with categorical decisions, and by supervising the model on a large-scale chain-of-thought dataset that grounds each decision in explicit visual evidence. Applied as a single post-hoc step, RefineAny3D delivers consistent gains across closed-set detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, and 3D auto-labeling tools, and generalizes to novel categories, scenes, and cameras without retraining.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [179] [Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07525)
*Pengfei Zhou,Jiajun Song,Zhiwei Tang,Yixing Ma,Xiaopeng Peng,Donghui Si,Yuhang Xu,Huiqi Song,Yiyuan Miao,Yichen Qian,Weihua Chen,Wangbo Zhao,Bohan Zhuang,Jiasheng Tang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个系统性的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）幻觉评估框架，包含细粒度基准UniHall和自适应的多模态模糊测试方法SAMF，揭示了模型在模糊测试下的性能显著退化以及"帮助性-幻觉"权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM幻觉评估依赖静态基准，存在分类覆盖狭窄和性能饱和的问题，无法反映模型在真实动态场景中的鲁棒性，亟需更全面的评估框架。

Method: 首先构建基于统一分类体系（涵盖对象、指令、知识三个维度）的细粒度数据集UniHall；其次提出Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing（SAMF）框架，采用进化突变策略探索幻觉边界，并通过多模态oracle集成驱动的结构化指标套件确保动态输入评估的可靠性。

Result: 实验表明，最先进的MLLMs在模糊测试下相比常规设置出现显著性能退化，暴露了推理能力与事实依据之间的脱节；同时发现了帮助性-幻觉权衡，即强化学习对齐在指令跟随任务中会加剧谄媚行为。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了动态评估对MLLM幻觉检测的重要性，以及对齐训练可能带来的负面副作用，为未来模型鲁棒性评估和训练策略提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.

</details>


### [180] [DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07527)
*Hongchen Wei,Yuanzhe Wang,Bei Liu,Yifan Yang,Qi Dai,Kai Qiu,Yunsheng Li,Dongdong Chen,Chong Luo,Zhenzhong Chen,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DocAtlas是一个将长文档理解建模为可变状态信息检索过程的系统，通过外部可变的文档工具环境（支持搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具）管理文档信息的访问与存储。在MMLongBench-Doc上，搭配GPT-5.4达到71.4%（超过人类专家65.8%），而用端到端强化学习训练的Qwen3.5-4B小型VLM达到了63.7%，远超直接输入的54.4%基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的检索增强系统通常在生成前从静态索引中选择证据，而智能体系统虽支持多轮工具调用但依赖冻结的商业模型且行为由提示词决定。作者希望克服静态索引和固定背板的局限，将长文档理解视为一个可变的、动态的信息寻求过程，使系统能够在推理过程中主动决定搜索、读取、存储和回顾哪些信息。

Method: DocAtlas将长文档理解实现为一个"可变文档工具环境"（mutable document harness）：外部环境决定每一步搜索、阅读、存储、回顾和展示什么文档信息。该系统提供搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具，维护一个层次化文档树和笔记存储，并随智能体记录证据而动态更新。DocAtlas结合了自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆，在固定上下文预算下工作。同一环境既支持大型VLM的推理时使用，也支持端到端强化学习训练紧凑型VLM智能体。

Result: 在MMLongBench-Doc基准上，DocAtlas配合GPT-5.4达到71.4%的准确率，超过了人类专家65.8%的参考水平。使用Qwen3.5-4B小型VLM在DocAtlas环境中通过端到端强化学习训练，达到63.7%的准确率，相比54.4%的直接输入基线提升了9.3个百分点，表明可变文档工具环境设计能大幅提升紧凑型文档智能体的性能。

Conclusion: DocAtlas通过将文档理解重构为可变状态的信息寻求过程，证明了外部可变的文档工具环境设计既能提升大型VLM在长文档理解任务上的表现（超越人类专家），也能通过端到端强化学习显著增强紧凑型VLM智能体的能力，为长文档理解系统提供了一种新的范式。

Abstract: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.

</details>


### [181] [WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07529)
*Yi Zhang,Hongyang Wang,Zheng Hao Leong,Zihao Wu,Kaijun Lin,Zhixing Pan,Qixun Huangfu,Wei Ren,Wenyan Wu,Fangyun Wang,Wenting Yu,Hengyu Lin,Muling Yang,Zongguo Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了WuYuEval，一个面向固体废物管理（SWM）领域的多层次大语言模型评估基准，包含基础模块（4,590道选择题）和专家模块（247道情景开放题），系统评估了33个LLM在基础知识和专业决策两个层面的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准强调通用知识，难以评估其在固体废物管理这一需要工程、环境和政策约束下进行专业决策的实际能力，需要专门的领域评估基准。

Method: 构建WuYuEval基准，分为基础模块（4,590道多选选择题，覆盖6种任务类型和8个领域类别）和专家模块（247道基于情景的开放题，涉及多目标优化、约束权衡和系统设计）。专家任务采用锚定校准的LLM-as-a-Judge评分结合Elo成对比较。

Result: 在33个LLM上的评估显示：最佳模型基础模块准确率达94.64%，但平均准确率从易题的84.14%降至难题的42.50%；计算、实验设计、城市规划和开放型专家任务表现较差；基于推理的Thinking模式在多数匹配模型对中有所改善，但提升取决于基线能力且并非普遍正向。

Conclusion: 可见的推理只有在锚定于单位、假设和工程约束时才有效，否则可能偏离决策边界。WuYuEval为开发面向SWM的专业基础模型提供了评估资源和实证基础，强调专业推理链和显式约束控制的重要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

</details>


### [182] [Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07531)
*Cheng Ruoxi,Ma Haoxuan,Zhang Hongyi,Zhang Junming,Duan Ranjie,Xia Qiaolin,Wang Hao,Lu Yu,Shi Haibo,Ma Xingjun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Search-G1是一个基于表征的内在奖励框架，通过提示状态读出器（预测闭卷充分性，其补集定义为检索必要性）和答案承诺读出器（通过证据删除敏感性估计证据依赖程度）两个干预校准的读出器来评估智能体答案的操作性操作基础。该奖励无需过程注释或LLM评判推理，通过周期性地在新检查点上重新拟合读出器与策略共同进化。实验表明它改善了基础—搜索成本权衡，在竞争性任务准确率下产生更短的响应侧轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索增强语言代理的外部奖励要么只提供稀疏的结果监督，要么依赖昂贵的过程注释和LLM评判；而基于策略侧信号（熵、似然性、信息增益）的内部奖励虽然成本低，但主要反映模型置信度而非证据基础。需要一个既能衡量检索必要性和证据依赖程度、又无需昂贵注释或推理的内部奖励。

Method: 提出Search-G1框架，包含两个干预校准的基于表征的读出器：(1)提示状态读出器预测闭卷充分性，其补集定义为策略相对的检索必要性；(2)答案承诺读出器通过答案阶段对证据删除的敏感性来估计证据依赖。奖励对必要的检索和证据敏感的正确答案给予额外信用，对充分满足的正确答案给予奖励，并惩罚重复搜索。由于RL会改变策略表征，该方法周期性地用最新检查点的轨迹重新拟合两个读出器。

Result: 在多个基于搜索的问答基准和两个模型规模上的实验表明，Search-G1改善了基础—搜索成本权衡，在保持竞争性任务准确率的同时产生更短的响应侧轨迹。

Conclusion: Search-G1通过表征驱动的内在奖励有效地实现了检索必要性和证据基础的量化，提供了无需昂贵注释或LLM评判推理的奖励方案，并在搜索成本与答案准确性之间取得更优的平衡。

Abstract: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

</details>


### [183] [Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07594)
*Guide Labs Team,Andreas Madsen,Aya Abdelsalam Ismail,Giang Nguyen,Isaac Plant,Muawiz Chaudhary,Nathaniel Monson,Saqib Azim,Zhichen Guo,Julius Adebayo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文挑战"可解释性是能力的负担"这一传统观点，提出将可解释性作为训练约束与语言建模目标共同优化。在三个数量级的计算规模下（涵盖自回归和扩散语言模型），可解释性随能力增长而提升。作者以Steerling-8B实例化该方法，该模型具备归因、概念理解和训练数据追溯能力，支持无需重训的概念引导干预，且在显著更少的计算量下与开放同行模型性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可解释性方法是在模型训练完成后的逆向工程，其可靠性难以验证。作者认为应将可解释性从"事后补救"转变为"训练期约束"，从根本上改变可解释性与能力之间的关系。

Method: 将可解释性作为训练管线中的约束条件，与语言建模目标联合优化。在自回归和扩散两类架构上跨三个数量级计算规模验证。实例化为Steerling-8B——一种带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，支持输出归因到输入token、人类可理解概念和训练数据，并实现闭环干预（诊断→检索→概念引导修正）。
